text:
emma: Quick sync — ACME asked for 7y retention on audit logs + per-tenant BYOK. Need cost/ops calc to include in contract. Thoughts?

oliver: saw this in the demo. They want an export SLA (4h) and on-demand encrypted snapshots. Willing to pay but wants a firm cap and proof-of-evidence.

rafael: 7 years is nontrivial. Ballpark: ~60TB/year of audit data at their scale unless we dedupe aggressively. Cold-archive + gzip + dedupe required. Rough extra infra: +storage +cold egress. Can we do tiered retention lanes?

sasha: Security: BYOK per-tenant is ok in principle but we need a keystore handshake, attestation, and rotation logs for SOC2. Also auditors will expect immutable chain-of-custody metadata for exports.

emma: Proposal: retention lanes = 
- standard: 30d (default)
- premium: 1y
- longtail: 7y (archival)
Rollout plan: pilot with 1 customer on longtail. Launch criteria: export API, keystore handshake, retention toggle in Console, escalation runbook, billing SKU.

oliver: customer asked for timeline. Can we pilot in Q3? They need it for contract start.

rafael: dev effort estimate (very rough) —
- export pipeline + secure packaging: 3–4w
- cold-tiering + lifecycle jobs: 6w (infra + infra-tests)
- console toggles + billing hooks: 2w
Total: ~11–12w including QA. Depends on parallelism.

emma: so pilot ~10–12w. Pricing approach idea: base subscription + per-GB archival fee + retention surcharge multiplier. Also add an on-demand export/ingest egress fee.

ops-bot: @emma created task INF-7832: "export pipeline + retention tiering" assigned to infra backlog.

oliver: negotiating point: cap out-of-scope egress at 2TB/mo before extra charges. Also they want evidence packaging (signed manifest + checksums) for legal.

rafael: agree we should set retrieval SLOs for longtail: 24–48h typical, with emergency fast-path on paid plan. Add runbook for retrieval.

sasha: add to acceptance checklist: KMS attestation report, rotation logs, HSM-backed keys for top-tier customers, and retention-metadata preserved for SOC2 evidence.

emma: action items: Rafael -> infra estimate doc + cost numbers by EOD Tue; Sasha -> security acceptance checklist + sample attestation text; Oliver -> coordinate legal + customer comms and push timeline. I'll draft the pricing sketch and the pilot playbook. If anyone disagrees call it out here. :thumbsup:
